tei:div.tei:p: (na)༄༅// rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sngags btu'i rjes gnang bya tshul gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i snying thig ces bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo gu ru badz+ra yo gi n+yai/ dbang sngon rdul brtsegs lhun po la// thun mtshams sprin gyis 'khyud pa lta'i// he ru ka dpal yab yum dang*// dbyer med bla ma'i zhabs btud de// dpa' mo mkha' 'gro ma lus pa'i// gsang ba'i rig sngags oṃ gsum ma// btus nas byin rlabs bya ba'i tshul// tshad ldan gzhung bzhin brjod par bya// 'dir rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gzungs sngags oṃ gsum ma btus nas byin rlabs bya tshul la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ mjug chog go /dang po la gnyis/ slob dpon gyi bya ba'i sngon 'gro dang*/ slob ma la bya ba'i sngon 'gro'o// dang po ni/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob dpon gyis gnas khang bdud rtsis byugs pa la me tog gi sil ma gcal du dgram/ rdo dril cang te'u/ las bum/ phyi nang gi mchod pa/ gtor ma/ tshogs rdzas/ bgegs sbyong gi chas/ 'thor 'bru sogs 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad spyi dang*/ khyad par ras sogs 'bri gzhi gtsang ma la/ phag mo gzhung drug gi nang tshan ri khrod dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i zhal gnyis ma chung ba'i sgrub thabs las/ de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba// gsang sngags btu ba'i cho ga mchog /gru gsum dkyil 'khor nyams dga' ba// rdo rje rol pa las byung ba// chos kyi 'byung gnas zhes bshad cing*// btsun mo'i bha ga zhes kyang ngo*// ā li kā li'i dbye bas der// sde tshan brgyad kyi rim pa ni// gza

1 ུgas me 2 mda' 5 dang thub pa 7 dang*// ba 9 ུga pa drag pa 11 ོ 'dod pa 13 nyid// re'u mig rnams la rim bzhin du// man ngag gis ni dgod par bya// dang po a yig nas brtsams te// yi ge ha yi mthar thug par// g.yon skor gyi ni sbyor ba yis// bde mchog rgya mtshor gsungs bzhin bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ chos 'byung phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'i nang du re'u mig zhe dgu byas pa la/ k+ṣa yig ma gtogs pa'i dbyangs gsal gyi yi ge zhe dgu la dpe'u ris ltar bkod pa'i btu gzhi'i dkyil 'khor stegs bu'i steng du bzhag pa'i mthar mchod pa g.yon skor du bsham/ rje btsun ma'i mngon rtogs bsgom/ bsang chu bsgrub/ gtor mgron spyan drangs pa la gtor ma 'bul ba rnams bya'o// gnyis pa slob ma la bya ba'i sngon 'gro ni/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob ma la khrus phyag maṇ+ḍal bgegs sbyong chos bshad ci rigs kyi rjes su/ dpal mo rnal 'byor ma kun gyi// rig sngags bla na med pa'i gsung*// bklags pas don kun 'grub byed pa// dpa' bo chen pos bdag la stsol// ces gsol ba lan gsum 'debs su bcug la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom pa dbog go /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum/ sngags btu gzhi las ji ltar btu ba/ sngags byin gyis brlabs nas mchod pa/ sngags kyi rjes gnang bya tshul lo// dang po ni/ slob dpon gyis gzhung tshig rnams dag par bklags pa'i brjod don dang mthun par/ las kyi rdo rjes khrus long dri bzang gis byugs pa la/ sin+dhū ra/ gur gum/ gi'u wam̐/ bdud rtsi lnga rnams mtshal dang bsres pa'i snag tsa dang*/ gser ram mi rus sogs kyi smyu gus chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi mdun rgyab gnyis spangs pa'i gra bzhir dga' 'khyil dang nang gi dbus su bam̐ yig de'i mdun nas g.yon skor du oṃ gsum ma dbu phyir bstan phreng gcig la snyoms par bri'o// gzhung tshig ni// tha steng

o sum 'gyur byas nas ni// thig leṃ nā daṃs rnam par brgyan// bha steng ma tsha steng ba yi ge nyid// ṭa yi steng ma ra sa spyi bor brgyan// tsa sa'i dbus gnas ba blangs nas ni// ḍa yi 'og mas u 'og tu brgyan// sha steng nga sha log steng ma dha ni// de bzhin yang dag sbyar ba'o// l̥ thung 'og gi yi ge ḍa la// ha yi 'og mas ā rnam par brgyan// pa steng ka ta log 'og mas i brgyan// pha steng na tha log 'og ma ī sa bcing*// ha ṭa'i dbus gnas yi ge ya la// ṇa yi steng na gnas pas e brgyan// ṣa yi 'og na gnas pa ba gzung*// bha 'og stan du ṇa 'og ra bya// ha yi steng gnas yi ge wa nyid// ra yi steng ma ṇa nyis brtsegs la// ṭa yi steng ma ra spyi bor sbyar// pha yi steng na gnas na pa la// ṭha yi 'og na gnas pa ī sa brgyan// nya steng ya ṇa steng e gis brgyan pa// man ngag bzhin du shes par bya// tsa sa'i bar na gnas pa ba blang*// bha 'og dza stan du ṇa 'og ra sbyar// de bzhin tsha yi steng ma ba blang*// ta yi steng na gnas pa o sa brgyan// ṇa yi 'og mar ra tha steng o sbyar// pha yi 'og na gnas pa tsa blang*// dha pa'i dbus gnas yi ge na la// ṭha yi 'og mas ī rnam par brgyan// nya la'i dbus gnas yi ge ya la// ṇa yi steng mas e brgyan par bya// wa ma'i dbus gnas yi ge ha la// ṝ ring 'og ma ā gdags par bya// thigaṃ le nā daṃ yang dag ldan// sum 'gyur du ni bya ba yin// na 'og ra pha yi 'og mas dbye// snga ma bzhin du sum 'gyur bya// sha yi 'og ma sa tha 'og wa zhon// nya yi 'og na gnas pa ā sbyar// wa ma'i bar na gnas pa ha gzung*// dzha yi mdun gyi dbyangs ā kyis brgyan// bla ma'i man ngag lam gyis ni// gsang sngags btu ba'ang shes par bya// zhes pa'o// gnyis pa sngags byin gyis brlabs nas mchod pa ni/ btus pa'i sngags 'khor de btu gzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du mañji btsugs pa'i khar bzhag la/ khaṇ+ḍa ro his bsang*/

swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung dkyil zhes pa nas/ mkha' spyod chen po'i go 'phang thob par shog /ces pa'i bar mdun bskyed ltar sgrub cing mchod/ de nas mtshams 'dir yig cha logs su gsal ba ltar tshogs 'khor sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bar bya'o// gsum pa sngags kyi rjes gnang bya tshul ni/ slob ma khaṇ+ḍa ro his bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las slob ma rnams kyi go sar e e las chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ slob ma rnams rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur pa ni/ zhes pa nas/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// zhes pa'i bar gyis lhar bskyed la/ mdun bskyed kyi rje btsun ma dang*/ slob dpon dang slob ma rje btsun mar gsal ba gsum ga'i thugs kar chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bam̐ yig la oṃ gsum ma'i sngags phreng kha dog dmar pos g.yon skor du bskor bar bla slob gnyis kas gsal btab ste/ oṃ gsum ma'i rjes zlos lan gsum byed du bcug ste/ lan re re la mdun bskyed dang slob dpon gnyis ka'i thugs ka'i bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las rang 'dra gnyis pa re chad pa zhal nas thon/ slob ma rnams kyi kha nas zhugs te snying ga'i bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim pas gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags thams cad kyi byin rlabs thob par bsams la sum bsres byas pa'i mthar/ slob ma rnams kyis rang rang gi snying ga'i bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa la dmigs la/ nyi ma re re bzhin gzungs sngags chag med du bzla'o snyam pas lan bdun nam/ nyer gcig gam/ brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa dam bca' dang mthun par bzla'o// de nas slob dpon gyis btu gzhi dang btus pa'i 'khor lo'i yi ge rnams la g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis byug cing*/

slob ma rnams kyi spyi mgrin snying ga gsum du reg nas dbyangs gsal dang oṃ gsum ma brjod pas/ mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs thams cad 'od du zhu nas dbyangs gsal dang oṃ gsum ma'i yig 'bru'i rnam par gnas gsum nas lus la zhugs pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsam mo// de nas/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// zhes lan gsum zlos la me tog bla ma la dbul/ bla mas de blangs te sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs la/ slob ma rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag la/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa dang*/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad 'jug par gyur cig ces brjod do// de nas nang mchod kyis btu gzhi dang btus pa'i yi ge rnams bkrus la/ bla ma rang gis kyang btung zhing lus la byug slob ma rnams kyi'ang gnas gsum du byug cing*/ khyor bar byin pa 'thungs shing lus la byugs pas/ lus kyi cha shas rnams su de bzhin gshegs pa dang dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs rnams thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsam mo// gsum pa mjug chog ni/ slob ma rnams kyi gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo/ zhes sogs go cha dang*/ oṃ sum bha ni sum bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces sogs tsham ngams sngags kyi srung ba byas la/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal phul rjes/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /ces sogs smon lam dang*/ phun tshogs dge legs kun gyi dpal mnga' ba// zhes sogs shis brjod bya'o// smras pa/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i rtsa bshad rgyud kyi don// shā ba ri dang stong nyid ting nge 'dzin// bir+wa pa yi gzhung gis bkral ba gang*// sbas don kun gsal nyi mas phye mthong nas// a 'dus ka phreng ldan pa'i mtsho mjings las// oṃ gsum rgyan mdzes gsang sngags nor bu'i phreng*// btus nas snod rung gdul bya'i mgul rgyan du// byin 'di khyo min skyes pas sbrum bzhin sba// 'di ltar bskrun las byung ba'i rnam dkar dges// phyi nang mkha' la spyod pa'i dpal thob nas// sdug bsngal rgya mtsho'i klong byings ma rgan 'gro'i// skyabs mgon dpung gnyen mchog tu bdag gyur cig

/ces rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sngags btu'i rjes gnang bya tshul gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i snying thig ces bya ba 'di ni bde mchog gi rin chen bzhi'i sngags btu dang*/ nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i lung gsum gyi rjes gnang gi rgyun legs par thob pa'i ban+de dharma bha dras sa skyong gi lor dngul chu'i ri phug tu sbyar ba'o// //'dir 'khor lo gnyis yod/ btu gzhi'i 'khor lo g.yas/ btus pa'i 'khor lo g.yon/ ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
